The 1988–89 [[Primeira Liga|Primeira Divisão]] was the 55th season of [[Portuguese football league system|top-tier]] [[Association football|football]] in Portugal.

==Overview==
It was contested by 20 teams, and [[S.L. Benfica]] won the championship.
